text: Hi. I want you to keep track of the arrangements Alex and I make about Theo and about my work, and act on my calendar only with the ones that still hold.
Understood. I will record each arrangement as a card you confirm, keep the one that replaced which, and act only on cards still in force. When I am unsure I will show you the field and ask.
My two products are Loomstack and Pebblemail. Casey is my contractor on Loomstack, Devin does Pebblemail's design, Harper is a Pebblemail beta customer.
Noted as context, not as a decision: Loomstack (contractor Casey), Pebblemail (designer Devin, beta customer Harper). No card.
Let's set the order of importance. Booked travel comes first. Then Theo's pickups. Then meetings with other people. Then personal appointments. My own focus blocks come last.

card.quote: My own focus blocks come last

text: Recorded five priority cards, decided 2026-09-02 by you, in force now: travel rank 1, Theo's pickups rank 2, meetings rank 3, personal rank 4, focus blocks rank 5. Please confirm each.
Confirmed, all five.
Focus blocks may be moved for a meeting. Personal appointments may be moved too. Meetings, travel and pickups may not be moved by the assistant.

card.quote: Focus blocks may be moved for a meeting
Personal appointments may be moved too
Meetings, travel and pickups may not be moved by the assistant

text: Recorded three movable cards: focus blocks may be moved; personal appointments may be moved; meetings, travel and pickups may not be moved. All decided 2026-09-02, in force now.
Yes, confirmed.
Pebblemail beta starts next week, expect more calls with Harper.
Noted as context. No arrangement changed, so no card.
Tuesdays and Thursdays Alex picks up Theo. Robotics club runs 16:00 to 17:30 on those days.

card.quote: Tuesdays and Thursdays Alex picks up Theo

text: Recorded: Tuesdays and Thursdays Alex picks up Theo — decided 2026-09-08, in force now, one card on two seats (Tuesday, Thursday). The club hours are context, not an arrangement. Please confirm.
Confirmed.
Does the Tuesday pickup also cover the weeks Alex is on the late shift?

The records do not say. The only Tuesday arrangement is 'Tuesdays and Thursdays Alex picks up Theo' from 2026-09-08, with no exception for late shifts. Your question is recorded as a mention, not a decision.
By the way, on September 2nd we also agreed working hours: 09:00-17:00, Monday to Friday. Please record that.
Recorded working hours 09:00-17:00 Monday to Friday. Decided 2026-09-02 (as you say), recorded 2026-09-15 — the two dates are shown side by side on the card. In force from 2026-09-02. Please confirm.
Confirmed.
Loomstack 1.4 release is slipping, Casey needs another two weeks.
Noted as context. No card.
Should we ask Jordan to be a backup for pickups in general?

card.quote: Should we ask Jordan to be a backup for pickups in general?

text: That is a proposal, not a decision: recorded as 'proposes' and it holds no seat. Tell me when you and Jordan have agreed something.
Change of plan: Thursdays I pick up, backup Jordan — Alex is travelling Thursdays now.

card.quote: Thursdays I pick up, backup Jordan

text: Recorded: Thursdays you pick up, backup Jordan — decided 2026-10-03, in force now. It replaces the Thursday half of 'Tuesdays and Thursdays Alex picks up Theo' (2026-09-08); Tuesday stays with Alex. Please confirm the replacement.
Confirmed, replaces the Thursday part.
yeah Alex gets him Thursdays right?
No. Since 2026-10-03 Thursdays are you, backup Jordan; that replaced the September arrangement where Alex picked up. Your question is recorded as a mention and changes nothing.
Pebblemail launch is set for Monday November 2nd.
Noted as context. If the launch changes any arrangement, tell me in a sentence and I will make a card.
Found two old notes on the fridge, no idea when either is from. One says 'Saturdays Jordan picks up Theo from the showcase'. The other says 'Saturday showcase: Alex covers pickup'.

card.quote: Saturdays Jordan picks up Theo from the showcase

text: Recorded both as Saturday pickup cards with decided_at unknown, since you cannot date them and neither says it replaced the other. Until you tell me which one holds, any Saturday pickup conflict will be refused and both notes shown to you.
Fine, leave them both for now.
Is Jordan free on Saturdays generally?
The records do not say. Recorded as a mention.
From November 2nd, focus blocks may not be moved.

card.quote: From November 2nd, focus blocks may not be moved

text: Recorded: focus blocks may not be moved — decided 2026-10-20, in force from 2026-11-02 00:00. It replaces 'Focus blocks may be moved for a meeting' (2026-09-02) from that date; until then the old card holds. You did not say why, so the reason is recorded as 'the conversation does not say'. Please confirm.
Confirmed.
Why did I make focus blocks fixed again?
The conversation does not say. The card from 2026-10-20 states the rule and its start date; no reason was given. Recorded as a mention.
Loomstack offsite in Madison this Friday, flying back Saturday afternoon.

Noted as context: your calendar already has the flights. Saturday afternoon overlaps Theo's showcase pickup; I will raise it when you ask me to check conflicts — and I will have to refuse to plan it until the two Saturday notes are sorted out.
Denver trip for Pebblemail is Tuesday to Thursday next week.
Noted as context. Both pickups that week collide with flights; the Tuesday handoff would go to Alex and the Thursday one to Jordan, per the cards in force.
Clocks went back last night. Anything change?
Nothing in the ledger changed. From tomorrow the 2026-10-20 card is in force: focus blocks may not be moved.
Morning. Check my week for conflicts.
Checking. I will act only on cards in force and ask where a seat is empty, contradictory or undated.
